title: Yi Sun-sin dies winning the Battle of Noryang
summary: A combined Korean and Ming fleet attacked the Japanese fleet withdrawing from Korea in the Noryang strait. Admiral Yi Sun-sin was killed by a bullet during the battle.
reason: After Hideyoshi's death, Japan ordered its forces home, and the allies tried to destroy them before they escaped.
significance: It was the last major battle of the Imjin War.
place: Noryang Strait, near Namhae, South Korea
